commentary.text: 90+5' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+4' The attendance is 28923.
90+4' Haris Tabakovic (Hoffenheim) is quick to pounce on the rebound inside the penalty area and fires in a shot towards the roof of the net, but is denied by a reflex save from Moritz Nicolas.
90+3' Bastian Dankert blows his whistle after Tom Bischof (Hoffenheim) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
90+1' Corner kick. Tom Bischof (Hoffenheim) is ready to send the ball into the box.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
90' Valentin Gendrey (Hoffenheim) has the ability to send the ball deep into the penalty area from throw-ins and it can lead to very promising situations for his team.

89' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a promising strike towards the left post. Moritz Nicolas guesses his intentions and denies him with a fine save.
87' Tom Bischof (Hoffenheim) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.

87' Haris Tabakovic (Hoffenheim) was close to scoring a goal after unleashing a first-time effort from inside the six-yard box. The ball was aimed towards the right post, but the goalkeeper read it well and pulled off a brilliant save to thwart the attempt. Hoffenheim will take a corner kick.
86' Haris Tabakovic (Hoffenheim) wins a header inside the box after a cross and steers it goalwards, but Moritz Nicolas produces a wonderful reflex save.
86' That's the end of the game for Franck Honorat, who is replaced by Kevin Stoger (B. Monchengladbach).
86' Gerardo Seoane has decided to substitute Lukas Ullrich and he is replaced by Luca Netz (B. Monchengladbach).
86' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
86' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by David Jurasek (Hoffenheim), is intercepted by the opposition's defence. The ball is out of play. Hoffenheim will have a chance to score from a corner.
85' David Jurasek (Hoffenheim) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Moritz Nicolas intercepts the ball.

83' Valentin Gendrey (Hoffenheim) gets in a good position inside the box and is only inches away from getting on the end of a through ball from the edge of the area. The ball goes out of play and B. Monchengladbach will have a goal kick.
81' Here comes a substitution. Mergim Berisha (Hoffenheim) is brought on as a substitute for Adam Hlozek.
81' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Dennis Geiger (Hoffenheim) will replace Jacob Bruun Larsen.
81' We are about to witness a substitution. David Jurasek (Hoffenheim) is replacing Alexander Prass.
80' Gerardo Seoane decides to make a substitution. Alassane Plea will be replaced by Marvin Friedrich (B. Monchengladbach).
80' Substitution. Joe Scally makes way for Stefan Lainer (B. Monchengladbach).
79' Adam Hlozek (Hoffenheim) commits a foul after unfairly battling his opponent for the ball.
77' Adam Hlozek (Hoffenheim) latches onto a long ball into the box and unleashes a fine volley at goal, but flashes the effort just wide of the left post. That would have been a great goal!
74' A cross from Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
73' Joe Scally (B. Monchengladbach) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Bastian Dankert stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
70' Gerardo Seoane prepares a substitution. Robin Hack is replaced by Rocco Reitz (B. Monchengladbach).
70' Substitution. Haris Tabakovic (Hoffenheim) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Diadie Samassekou walks off.
70' Valentin Gendrey (Hoffenheim) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Adam Hlozek.
69' 12:5 – the total goal attempt statistics. The current number of shots on goal is 5:3.
65' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
63' Valentin Gendrey (Hoffenheim) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.

61' 1 - 2 Alassane Plea (B. Monchengladbach) finishes his beautiful individual effort with a superb strike from inside the box. Oliver Baumann is just a bystander as the ball flies into the bottom left corner. The score is 1:2.
58' 1 - 1 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) into the left of the net, giving goalkeeper Moritz Nicolas no chance!
58' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) is going to take the penalty!

57' Joe Scally (B. Monchengladbach) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Bastian Dankert blows his whistle for an infringement. That is a penalty kick for Hoffenheim.
55' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) puts a cross into the box from the free kick but it's cleared.
55' Bastian Dankert blows his whistle for a foul after Lukas Ullrich (B. Monchengladbach) hacks down one of his opponents. Hoffenheim have a free kick.
54' Neat link-up play between Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) and Alassane Plea, but Oliver Baumann reads the game well and the move breaks down.
52' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) inside the box following a slide rule pass.

52' Diadie Samassekou (Hoffenheim) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards the top left corner. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Moritz Nicolas pulls off an easy save.
50' Bastian Dankert interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach).
49' Jacob Bruun Larsen (Hoffenheim) picks up the ball inside the penalty box and immediately fires a first-time effort that sails well over the crossbar and ends in the stands.
46' Bastian Dankert blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+4' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' Alassane Plea (B. Monchengladbach) sends in a lofted cross from a long-range free kick in order to find one of his teammates. His poor effort, however, sails way out of play.

45+3' Referee Bastian Dankert sees the trip by Anton Stach (Hoffenheim) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. It's a free kick to B. Monchengladbach, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
45+2' Adam Hlozek (Hoffenheim) latched on to a cross into the box and headed the ball under the crossbar. A decent header but it lacked power, allowing the goalkeeper to make a comfortable save.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
45' The goal by B. Monchengladbach is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to an offside.
45' The goal for B. Monchengladbach is subject to a VAR review by the referee! He's obviously unsure or he received a message.
45' Oliver Baumann (Hoffenheim) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.

45' GOAL! Alassane Plea finds himself with the ball at his feet in space after a lightning counter attack. He looks and up slides the ball to Tim Kleindienst (B. Monchengladbach), who coolly slots the ball past the keeper from close in. It’s 0:2.
42' One of the players from B. Monchengladbach times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
41' Valentin Gendrey (Hoffenheim) reacts well near the penalty spot to connect with the resulting corner, but fails to direct his header into the back of the net. The ball floats high over the bar.
41' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.

40' Alexander Prass (Hoffenheim) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Hoffenheim.
40' Anton Stach (Hoffenheim) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
40' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim).

39' Tom Bischof (Hoffenheim) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous effort towards the right post is blocked by Moritz Nicolas, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net. The ball goes behind for a corner. Hoffenheim will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
39' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
38' A cross into the box from Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) is cleared. The referee signals a corner kick to B. Monchengladbach.
36' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
35' Bastian Dankert blows his whistle. Alexander Prass (Hoffenheim) commits a foul after dangerous play.
34' Stanley Nsoki is substituted due to injury. Christian Ilzer gives a chance to Robin Hranac (Hoffenheim).
34' The injury to Stanley Nsoki (Hoffenheim) looks like it might have ended his involvement in this match.
32' The game is interrupted now, Stanley Nsoki (Hoffenheim) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
31' Jacob Bruun Larsen (Hoffenheim) chips a pass over the line of defenders to get the ball to Kevin Akpoguma, but his attempt is intercepted and cleared.
30' Jacob Bruun Larsen (Hoffenheim) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
29' Tom Bischof (Hoffenheim) takes the corner which is cleared.
29' Alexander Prass (Hoffenheim) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. Hoffenheim earn a corner.

29' Tom Bischof (Hoffenheim) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the middle of the target, but Moritz Nicolas was alert and the score remains the same.
27' Adam Hlozek (Hoffenheim) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates.
26' Neat link-up play between Alassane Plea (B. Monchengladbach) and Robin Hack, but Oliver Baumann reads the game well and the move breaks down.
25' Tom Bischof (Hoffenheim) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
23' 0 - 1 Philipp Sander (B. Monchengladbach) receives a cross from a well-taken corner kick and fires a low shot in off the right post.
23' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.

22' Philipp Sander (B. Monchengladbach) releases a low pass from just outside the box in an attempt to find his teammate, but one of the defenders calmly averts the threat. B. Monchengladbach force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
21' The corner from Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) is cleared away by the defence.

21' Philipp Sander (B. Monchengladbach) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. B. Monchengladbach will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
19' Tim Kleindienst (B. Monchengladbach) commits a foul and Bastian Dankert immediately signals a free kick.
18' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it.
18' Adam Hlozek (Hoffenheim) is caught offside by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.
16' Alexander Prass (Hoffenheim) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Moritz Nicolas, who smothers the ball.
15' Tom Bischof (Hoffenheim) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
15' Adam Hlozek (Hoffenheim) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The linesman points to the corner flag, Hoffenheim are going to take it.
10' Alexander Prass (Hoffenheim) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Andrej Kramaric.
9' Lukas Ullrich (B. Monchengladbach) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
8' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
7' A pass from Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) is intercepted by Oliver Baumann and the move breaks down.
6' Chance! Adam Hlozek (Hoffenheim) comes within inches of scoring after picking up a pass from Jacob Bruun Larsen, but his shot from inside the box flashes inches wide of the left post.
5' A promising cross into the box is nearly received by the lurking Jacob Bruun Larsen (Hoffenheim), but one of the defending players cuts it out to avert the threat.
4' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) sends a long ball in, but Oliver Baumann comfortably gathers the ball.
2' Tim Kleindienst (B. Monchengladbach) climbs high to connect with a cross near the penalty spot but plants a header well wide of the left post.
2' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) fails to deliver a decent cross from the corner and the ball goes out of play.

1' Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a low shot in the direction of the left post. Oliver Baumann is alert and denies him with a nice save. B. Monchengladbach have a corner.
1' The first half has started.
